title: Remove the lxml workaround for the Amazon provider
body:
The workaround is no longer needed now that redshift-connector [2.1.13](https://github.com/aws/amazon-redshift-python-driver/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#v2113-2026-03-30) was released.
